note.p: A frequent visitor to the Chapter Coffee House, he was described by a contemporary as an 'urbane and able physciain from Middlesex' and was associated with Dr Buchan and George Fordyce

Ed Pope notes: Dr Charles Gower matric Oriel College Oxford 1783 age 19, physician to Middlesex Hospital 1800, Holden's 1811 17 Old Burlington St, Morning Post 6.2.1821 sale of his library, buried 2.4.1822 St Dunstan i t West, of Carey St, from Serle's Coffee House. Monk's Roll implies he was not financially successful as a doctor. John Timbs, Clubs and Club Life in London said he was a member of Wittanegemot Club in Chapter Coffee House. Smith of Newman St may have been John Rubens Smith son of John Raphael Smith.

person.bibl: John Times, Club life of London with anecdotes of the clubs, coffee-houses and taverns of the metropolis during the 17th, 18th, and 19th centuries, 2 vols (London: Richard Bentley, 1866)
